title: Hat Of Uproarious Laughter

sources.title: Slippery Slapsticky
markers: | summary = '''Slippery Slapsticky''' is a passive feature that causes low intelligence creatures to fall on the floor, laughing.

summary: When a hostile creature with Intelligence 5 or higher is knocked Prone within 30 ft, it must make a Wisdom save or suffer Hideous Laughter.

fields.Use: When a hostile creature with Intelligence 5 or higher is knocked Prone within 30 ft, it must make a Wisdom save or suffer Hideous Laughter.
fields.Base value: 35 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
